## Integer variable

Helpers that produce [Integer](./contracts.integer.md) values. The value shares its name with the type, so the conversions are found exactly where a type error names `Integer`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
Integer: IntegerHelpers
```

## Example

```ts
setCount(Integer.validate(count)) // count must already be an integer
setCount(Integer.round(average)) // or choose a conversion explicitly
```
